cause_quote: The new loopback-bundle-mcp.ts acquired configured MCP with `requesterSenderId: undefined` ("Requester-scoped servers need a verified sender, which completions and automations lack"), so requester-scoped servers were never materialized on Claude CLI turns.
user_saw: On Claude CLI turns, a user's per-requester OAuth or resolver-based MCP server tools were missing entirely, with no notice, while the default runtime listed and called them.
summary: Serves requester-scoped MCP tools on Claude CLI loopback turns via the shared harness materializer (bound to the turn's verified sender), and lists the sign-in tool with an explicit refusal on senderless turns.
reasoning: #172026 introduced the loopback bridge for configured MCP on managed Claude CLI turns and deliberately passed `requesterSenderId: undefined`, documenting that requester-scoped servers are not offered; the fix adds them. Before #172026 the native Claude CLI path also never carried requester-scoped servers (native projection resolves OAuth with operator identity and omits unavailable servers; docs say requester-scoped servers never enter harness-native config), so this capability never worked on Claude CLI rather than regressing; medium confidence because the omission was a documented choice and could be read as a feature gap.
